company.shortDescription: Propaya uses AI to instantly analyze leases, delivering clause-cited insights, benchmarks, and data to drive smarter CRE deals.
company.description: Propaya uses AI to instantly abstract and analyze commercial leases - delivering clause-cited insights, linked schedules, and export-ready data in minutes. Beyond lease reviews, we empower brokers and attorneys with market benchmarks and deal evaluation tools to negotiate smarter, faster.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven tool that analyzes commercial leases to extract key data and clauses, providing detailed lease breakdowns within minutes for export and review.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Commercial Lease Abstraction and Review

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature that standardizes lease data across multiple properties and tenants, providing source citations and organized storage for consistent lease information management.
productsAndServices.name: Lease Data Standardization and Centralized Management

productsAndServices.description: A tool that automatically detects potential risks and anomalies in lease agreements, such as unfavorable clauses or missing signatures, to assist legal teams in due diligence.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Risk Identification in Lease Documents

productsAndServices.description: Tools that generate rent tables and financial metrics like revenue, expenses, and NOI from lease data to support portfolio performance comparison and investment decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Portfolio Analysis Tools
